name: kokoro-reader
description: Format rich content with beginner-friendly visual Markdown and narration, then send it to the local Kokoro Reader.

interface.shortDescription: Send readable Markdown to local Kokoro speech.
interface.longDescription: Convert rich Markdown into aligned visual and narration sections, add simple Unicode diagrams when they improve understanding, then send it to the local Kokoro Reader app for focused, offline playback.
defaultPrompt: Format these notes for listening in Kokoro.
